{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify deduplication worked
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f'Expected 800 unique patients, got {len(df_dedup)}'

# Check arm and severity distribution after deduplication
print('Arm distribution after deduplication:')
print(df_dedup['arm'].value_counts())
print('\nSeverity distribution after deduplication:')
print(df_dedup['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if the arms are balanced by severity
print('\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity']))"}
